modalLead: Glances arrives: a page for the hosts you run it on, and a widget for the dashboard. Berry is the default theme, and a domain's expiry date is one more thing nextDash watches for you.

items.text: A Glances page. Overview, Processes, Containers, Disks, Network, History and more for every host you run Glances on. Click a process or a container for its side panel, open an incident to see its cause, compare with last week and save a graph as an image. Press Shift+G to open it.
items.title: A Glances view for your hosts

media.alt: The Glances page: the overview of a host, then the Processes tab with the side panel of one process open

items.text: A Glances widget. One host on the dashboard, as meters or as the processor graph over the last hour. It links to the page for that host.
items.title: One host on your dashboard

media.alt: Two Glances tiles on the dashboard: one host as meters, another as a processor graph, beside the processor and memory tiles

items.text: Several hosts, and notices. Pick the host you look at, or see them all in one table. A notice warns when a disk is filling up, and the Containers view reads CPU, memory and network from Glances on your Docker host.

Domain expiry. A widget, a badge in Bookmarks and an alert tell you when a domain registration runs out. Registries that publish no date are named in a group of their own, so a quiet list never looks like a clean one.
items.title: Know before a domain expires

media.alt: The Domains widget listing the registrations that run out soon, with the days left, and a quiet group of domains whose registry shows no date

items.text: Berry is the default theme. A new install starts on Berry. If you are on another theme, a card offers it once, and Go back undoes it. Your own theme stays as it is.
Easier to read. Secondary text in the default themes has more contrast, inputs show a clear focus ring, and six backdrops are refreshed.
Add new bookmark from a category. Right-click a category's header and the first entry opens the add-bookmark form with that category already chosen.

Search keeps your letters. The first letter you type stays as you typed it, and Escape in the bookmark grid leaves the grid, so j and k are letters for the search again. Cancelling a search no longer puts the cursor on the first row.
Better on a phone. Bigger tap targets, overlays that fit the screen and Config tabs that fade at the edge.
